# Repository-wide Copilot Instructions: MAID Yard Manager
Read `docs/maid/PRODUCT_SCOPE_V1.md`, `docs/maid/WEB_MOBILE_PARITY.md`, `docs/maid/INTEGRATIONS_AND_MODELS.md`, and `docs/maid/CERTIFICATION_AND_AUTONOMY.md` before proposing implementation.
You are implementing MAID Yard Manager, a fork/derivative of upstream MAID, preserving its licensed local GGUF and remote provider features. The original MAID is NOT a LangGraph manager and cannot be called certified before test evidence.
Current repo is staging/bootstrap. Import pinned upstream source 60206bd164bbe271e74543cc616de5f2278da511 through a reviewable branch with LICENSE before adding any derivative code. GitHub default branch is master. Avoid force, rewriting history, overwriting existing user projects, or using non-repo secrets.
All code modular TypeScript first; a LangGraph.js graph exposed through small Cloudflare Worker endpoints, durable state in DO/D1 where feasible, authenticated independent yard agent; model router and integration contracts, full Android/desktop/mobile web parity, independent CI.
Never claim unexecuted commands, test outcomes or release readiness. Include exact failing command/log and next fix in PR if blocked. Never merge own high-risk PR without review. Do not bypass host safeguards, authentication, environmental restrictions, or production guards.
Prioritize feature parity, security isolation, performance/free quota, UX accessibility, and real device evidence. Own the task until the issue's acceptance tests pass; document unresolved prerequisites without guessing. Scope execution to assigned issue. Long tasks are checkpoints not unbounded busy loops. Preserve owner approval gates for privileged/destructive actions and final production release.
